anchors: FENOR-02 p.2 Fig.5(c): -0.5 V, 20 ns read endurance stress pulse; not full read-cycle measurement

value.meaning: 20/40/80 ns are complete local binary-read engineering allowances for the stated lateral resources, not extracted confidence bounds; no ADC is used.

value.node_count_definition: 16 independently controlled BLs + 16 SLs + 4 layer WL segments
value.scope: Local level-shifted rail drivers and isolation, not a measured FeFET driver macro; C and current are explicit design limits that support 5/10/20 ns transitions. Supply rails are already available locally. No off-boundary rail startup is claimed.
value.source_bridge: FENOR-02 p.3 Fig.9 supplies voltage selection; Fig.11 supplies RC scale. Neither supplies measured bias-driver settling.
value.fixed_resource_rule: Counts and current ratings are identical in all main scenarios; actual 5/10/20 ns edge requirements are checked against the fixed 60 uA/node and 17.28 mA supply ratings. Reference 7.68 mA is the 10 ns edge demand, not the installed supply ceiling.

fixed_parameters: all primitive IDs not listed above retain exactly input.json normalized values; schedules/resources and unclosed budgets remain unchanged
